title: Sony LinkBuds S WF-LS900N True Wireless Earbuds
description_en: Sony's most versatile true wireless earbuds combine class-leading noise cancellation with an ambient sound mode so natural you forget you're wearing earbuds. 6-hour battery, IPX4 splash-proof, and the smallest form factor in Sony's lineup.
description_ja: ソニーのトゥルーワイヤレスイヤホン。業界トップのノイキャンと、自然な外音取り込みを両立。6時間連続再生・IPX4防滴・ソニー史上最小設計。
